GOVT. OF NATIONAL CAPITAL TERRITORY OF DELHI
DIRECTORATE OF EDUCATION: PHYSICAL EDUCATION BRANCH
CHHATRASAL STADIUM: MODEL TOWN: DELHI – 110009

Subject: Drawing, Speech Competitions and “Meri Seva, Mera Sankalp” – Student Reel
Making Competition under “Sewa Sankalp Abhiyan” from 17.09.2026 to 17.10.2026 in
Government Schools of NCT of Delhi.

The Directorate of Education, Government of NCT of Delhi, is pleased to announce the
organisation of various student-centric activities under “Sewa Sankalp Abhiyan”, with the
objective of providing students an opportunity to express their ideas, creativity and aspirations
relating to public service, development, nation-building and the vision of “Viksit Bharat
@2047”. The Abhiyan seeks to highlight the journey of public service over the past 25 years
and create awareness among students regarding various welfare and development initiatives.

Accordingly, all Heads of Government Schools of NCT of Delhi are directed to ensure active
participation of students in the following competitions:
1. “25 Crore Children’s Dreams of India” – Drawing & Speech Competition

Themes for Drawing & Speech Competition:

• 25 years of public service and major welfare/development initiatives.
• Vision of a Developed India – Viksit Bharat @2047.
2. Theme for “Meri Seva, Mera Sankalp” – Student Reel Making Competition

Students may create short reels/videos highlighting the following themes:

• Seva Mera Yogdan – My Contribution to Society.
• Acts of kindness, compassion and community service.
• Youth participation in nation-building.
• Public service and its impact on people's lives.
• Jan Bhagidari – People's Participation in Nation Building.
• Cleanliness, environmental protection and civic responsibility.
• Helping the elderly, persons in need and vulnerable sections of society.
• Respect for public property and national symbols.
• Innovative ideas for social good.
• Viksit Bharat @2047 – My Vision, My Contribution.
• Inspiring stories of individuals/communities contributing to society.
